items.summary: Maintain a three-site preview-only launch pipeline: complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net. For each, retain a bounded packet covering site brief, reusable template, content seed, SEO baseline, analytics/affiliate readiness, compliance, security, owner, rollback, and launch gate. No domain changes, spending, deployment, analytics configuration, monetization, or public launch is authorized.

Strongest candidate is complicated.work based on the validated site-factory build score of 84 and existing scaffold. Its build remains blocked until the existing readiness packet contains dated owner assignment, preview/build evidence, content and SEO seed, measurement boundary, compliance baseline, security disposition, rollback point, and explicit blocker evidence. Capacity is saturated, so no implementation request should be admitted.

The repeatable launch gate is: owner confirmed; legal/compliance disposition recorded; security and release evidence recorded; preview/build quality checks pass; SEO metadata, sitemap, and crawlability baseline documented; analytics and affiliate measurement boundaries documented without inventing telemetry; rollback point recorded; then explicit owner approval for launch. Until all gates pass, keep each candidate parked, private, preview-only, and unlaunched.
